## Why This Is Asked

This question assesses the ability to design tenant-scoped, auditable CI/CD pipelines with strict governance gates, drift detection, and lifecycle management across regions.

## Key Concepts

- **Tenant Isolation**: Per-tenant resource groups with dedicated Key Vault, App Configuration, and App Service instances
- **Idempotent Provisioning**: ARM templates or Terraform with conditional logic to safely re-run without duplicate resources
- **Run-from-package**: Blob storage-based deployment for improved performance and simplified rollback
- **Deployment Slots**: Staging/production slots with traffic routing for zero-downtime releases
- **Feature Flags**: App Configuration-based flag management with per-tenant overrides
- **Health Checks**: Per-tenant endpoint monitoring integrated with slot swapping
- **Drift Detection**: Baseline comparison against ARM/Git templates to identify configuration deviations
- **Policy Gates**: Azure Policy for resource compliance and OPA Gatekeeper for custom admission control
- **Cross-Region Failover**: Traffic Manager or Azure Front Door for geographic redundancy
- **Comprehensive Auditing**: Azure Monitor Logs with tenant-scoped diagnostics and Log Analytics queries

## Code Example

```yaml
# onboarding-pipeline.yml
trigger: none
pr: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
  - name: action
    type: string
    default: onboard
    values: [onboard, offboard]
  - name: environment
    type: string
    default: dev
    values: [dev, staging, prod]

variables:
  rgName: 'rg-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
  appConfigName: 'appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
  kvName: 'kv-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
  appServiceName: 'app-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'

stages:
  - stage: Validate
    displayName: 'Dry-Run Validation'
    jobs:
      - job: ValidateTemplates
        displayName: 'Validate ARM Templates'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceManagerTemplateDeployment@3
            displayName: 'What-If Deployment Preview'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              location: '$(location)'
              templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
              csmFile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/infra/main.bicep'
              csmParametersFile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/infra/params/${{ parameters.tenantId }}.json'
              deploymentMode: 'Validation'
              
  - stage: PolicyGate
    displayName: 'Policy Compliance Gate'
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - job: CheckPolicyCompliance
        displayName: 'Azure Policy & OPA Gate'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@0
            displayName: 'Check Azure Policy Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              
          - task: Bash@3
            displayName: 'OPA Gatekeeper Validation'
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                kubectl get constrainttemplates
                # Custom OPA validation checks
                
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Resources'
    dependsOn: PolicyGate
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq('${{ parameters.action }}', 'onboard'))
    jobs:
      - job: CreateResources
        displayName: 'Create Tenant Resources'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceManagerTemplateDeployment@3
            displayName: 'Deploy Infrastructure'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              location: '$(location)'
              templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
              csmFile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/infra/main.bicep'
              csmParametersFile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/infra/params/${{ parameters.tenantId }}.json'
              deploymentMode: 'Incremental'
              
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Configure Key Vault'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              KeyVaultName: '$(kvName)'
              SecretsCertificateTemplate: '**/*.secret.json'
              
  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy Application'
    dependsOn: Provision
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq('${{ parameters.action }}', 'onboard'))
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployApp
        displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        environment: 'staging'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    appType: 'webApp'
                    appName: '$(appServiceName)'
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    packageForLinux: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/**/package.zip'
                    
        - job: HealthCheck
          displayName: 'Validate Health Endpoints'
          dependsOn: DeployApp
          steps:
            - task: AzureAppServiceSettings@1
              displayName: 'Configure Health Check'
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                appName: '$(appServiceName)'
                resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
                slotName: 'staging'
                healthCheckPath: '/health'
                
            - task: Bash@3
              displayName: 'Verify Health Endpoint'
              inputs:
                targetType: 'inline'
                script: |
                  # Poll health endpoint until ready
                  for i in {1..30}; do
                    status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://$(appServiceName)-staging.azurewebsites.net/health)
                    if [ "$status" -eq 200 ]; then
                      echo "Health check passed"
                      exit 0
                    fi
                    sleep 10
                  done
                  echo "Health check failed"
                  exit 1
                  
        - job: SwapSlots
          displayName: 'Swap to Production'
          dependsOn: HealthCheck
          condition: and(succeeded(), eq('${{ parameters.environment }}', 'prod'))
          steps:
            - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
              displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                Action: 'Swap Slots'
                ResourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
                WebAppName: '$(appServiceName)'
                SourceSlot: 'staging'
                
  - stage: ConfigureFeatureFlags
    displayName: 'Configure Feature Flags'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq('${{ parameters.action }}', 'onboard'))
    jobs:
      - job: SetupFeatureFlags
        displayName: 'Configure App Configuration'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: 'Set Feature Flags'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              AppConfigurationResourceGroup: '$(rgName)'
              AppConfigurationName: '$(appConfigName)'
              JSONContent: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/feature-flags/${{ parameters.tenantId }}.json'
              
  - stage: Offboard
    displayName: 'Offboard Tenant'
    dependsOn: Validate
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq('${{ parameters.action }}', 'offboard'))
    jobs:
      - job: CleanupResources
        displayName: 'Remove Tenant Resources'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
            displayName: 'Delete Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              action: 'DeleteRG'
              resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              
  - stage: Audit
    displayName: 'Audit & Logging'
    jobs:
      - job: StreamLogs
        displayName: 'Stream to Azure Monitor'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Query Audit Logs'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace $(logAnalyticsWorkspaceId) \
                  --query "AzureActivity | where ResourceGroup == '$(rgName)' | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Caller, TenantId"
                  
  - stage: Rollback
    displayName: 'Rollback Strategy'
    condition: failed()
    jobs:
      - job: RollbackDeployment
        displayName: 'Restore Previous Version'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Rollback to Previous Deployment'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              ResourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              WebAppName: '$(appServiceName)'
              SourceSlot: 'production'
              TargetSlot: 'staging'
```

## Why This Question Matters
This tests your ability to build ephemeral environments for PR reviews - a key DevOps skill. You need to show you understand AKS namespaces, Helm deployments, secret management, and cost control through automated cleanup.

## Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Azure DevOps Pipeline                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. Trigger: PR created/updated                                 │
│  2. Create Namespace (pr-{PR_ID})                               │
│  3. Deploy Helm charts to namespace                             │
│  4. Inject Key Vault secrets                                    │
│  5. Run integration tests                                      │
│  6. Update PR with environment URL                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Complete Pipeline YAML

```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - '*'

variables:
  aksClusterName: 'ephemeral-aks-cluster'
  resourceGroup: 'rg-ephemeral-environments'
  helmVersion: '3.14.0'
  prNamespace: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-ephemeral-secrets'

stages:
  - stage: Setup
    displayName: 'Create PR Environment'
    jobs:
      - job: CreateNamespace
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Connect to AKS'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create PR Namespace with Quotas'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl create namespace $(prNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
                cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
                apiVersion: v1
                kind: ResourceQuota
                metadata:
                  name: pr-quota
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  hard:
                    requests.cpu: '4'
                    requests.memory: 8Gi
                    pods: '20'
                ---
                apiVersion: v1
                kind: LimitRange
                metadata:
                  name: pr-limits
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  limits:
                    - default:
                        cpu: '1'
                        memory: 2Gi
                      defaultRequest:
                        cpu: '100m'
                        memory: 256Mi
                      type: Container
                EOF

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch PR Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to PR Environment'
    dependsOn: Setup
    jobs:
      - job: HelmDeploy
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure kubectl'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup)

          - task: HelmInstaller@1
            displayName: 'Install Helm'
            inputs:
              helmVersionToInstall: $(helmVersion)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy Helm Release'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                helm upgrade --install pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) ./charts/microservices 
                  --namespace $(prNamespace) --create-namespace 
                  --set image.tag=$(Build.BuildId) 
                  --set environment=pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) 
                  --wait --timeout 5m

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create CSI SecretProviderClass'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
                apiVersion: secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1
                kind: SecretProviderClass
                metadata:
                  name: pr-azure-kv-secret
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  provider: azure
                  parameters:
                    useVMManagedIdentity: "true"
                    vaultName: "$(keyVaultName)"
                    secrets: |
                      - secretName: db-connection-string
                        objectName: "pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)-db-connection"
                        objectType: secret
                EOF

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: IntegrationTests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Isolated Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                export DB_NAME="test_pr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)_orders"
                export TEST_USER_PREFIX="pr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)_test_"
                npm test -- --testPathPattern=integration

  - stage: Teardown
    displayName: 'Cleanup PR Environment'
    condition: eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')
    jobs:
      - job: CleanupResources
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Delete Namespace & Helm Release'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing
                helm uninstall pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) -n $(prNamespace) || true
                kubectl delete namespace $(prNamespace) --wait=true --timeout=5m || true
```

## TTL Cleanup Pipeline (Scheduled)

```yaml
trigger: none
schedules:
  - cron: '0 0 * * *'
    branches:
      include:
        - main

variables:
  aksClusterName: 'ephemeral-aks-cluster'
  resourceGroup: 'rg-ephemeral-environments'
  ttlHours: 48

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

steps:
  - task: AzureCLI@2
    displayName: 'Delete Expired PR Namespaces'
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing
        for NS in $(kubectl get ns -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@.metadata.name=~"^pr-")]} {.metadata.name} {end}'); do
          AGE_HOURS=$(($(date +%s) - $(date -d $(kubectl get ns $NS -o jsonpath='{.metadata.creationTimestamp}') +%s)) / 3600)
          if [ $AGE_HOURS -gt $(ttlHours) ]; then
            helm uninstall -n $NS || true
            kubectl delete ns $NS --wait=true
          fi
        done
```

## Security Considerations

| Area | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| Network Isolation | Azure Network Policy restricts pod-to-pod communication between PR namespaces |
| Secret Isolation | Per-PR Key Vault secrets with restricted access policies; use Managed Identity |
| RBAC | Cluster-level RoleBinding to limit PR deployment access |
| Registry | Private endpoints for container registry |

## Cost Optimization

1. **Shared Cluster**: Single AKS cluster amortizes control plane costs
2. **Auto-Scaling**: Enable cluster autoscaler and HPA
3. **TTL Cleanup**: 24-48 hour TTL prevents orphaned resources
4. **Spot Nodes**: Use spot/preemptible VMs (~60-80% savings)
5. **Resource Quotas**: Prevent PR monopolizing cluster resources

## Test Data Isolation

- Database naming: `orders_pr123`, `users_pr123`
- Test user prefixes: `pr123_test_user_001`
- Message queue topics: `pr123_orders`

## Telemetry Isolation

- Use custom dimension `pr_id` in Application Insights to filter PR-specific telemetry
- Tag all log queries with `environment=pr-{PR_ID}`

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of enterprise CI/CD practices with Azure DevOps, including infrastructure-as-code validation, secret management, feature flag implementation, blue-green deployments, approval gates, and monitoring integration.

## Key Concepts
- **ARM Template Validation**: Using arm-ttk to validate Azure Resource Manager templates before deployment
- **Secret Management**: Securely retrieving credentials from Azure Key Vault
- **Feature Flags**: Using Azure App Configuration for per-environment configuration
- **Staging Deployments**: Deploying to a staging slot for validation before production
- **Manual Gate**: Requiring manual approval before production deployment
- **Drift Detection**: Checking for configuration drift and logging to Log Analytics

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps YAML Pipeline demonstrating the complete workflow
trigger: main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  keyVaultName: 'prod-keyvault'
  appConfigName: 'prod-appconfig'
  appServiceName: 'linux-app-service'
  resourceGroup: 'prod-rg'
  logWorkspace: 'log-analytics-workspace'

stages:
  - stage: Validate
    jobs:
      - job: Validate_ARM
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group deployment validate \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file arm/template.json

      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: Python@1
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '3.10'
          - script: pip install pytest
            displayName: 'Install pytest'
          - script: pytest tests/
            displayName: 'Run unit tests'

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Staging_Slot
        environment: 'staging'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'

                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    KeyValueFilters: 'Environment=Staging'

                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroup)
                    location: 'eastus'
                    templateFile: 'arm/template.json'
                    parametersFile: 'arm/parameters.staging.json'

                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
                    appName: $(appServiceName)
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Production_Approval
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Wait_For_Approval
        pool:
          server: true
        steps:
          - task: ManualValidation@0
            timeoutInMinutes: 4320
            inputs:
              notifyUsers: '$(notifyEmail)'
              instructions: 'Please validate staging deployment and approve for production'
              onTimeout: 'reject'

  - stage: Deploy_Production
    dependsOn: Production_Approval
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Production
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureWebApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
                    appName: $(appServiceName)
                    deployToSlotOrASE: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    action: 'Swap Slots'

                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az monitor app-insights show \
                        --app $(appServiceName) \
                        --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                        --query properties.InstrumentationKey

                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: 'Log drift check to Log Analytics'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az monitor log-analytics query \
                        --workspace $(logWorkspace) \
                        --query "Cupertino | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)"
```

stages:

  jobs:

      matrix:
        tenantA: { tenant: 'tenant-a' }

                az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(rgName) --name $(aksCluster)
                kubectl set image deployment/api api=$(containerImage) --namespace=$(tenant)
          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: 'Fetch feature flags'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              appConfigurationResourceGroup: '$(rgName)'
              appConfigurationName: '$(appConfigName)'
              label: '$(tenant)'
          - task: Bash@3
            displayName: 'Run k6 synthetic tests'
            env:
              TENANT_URL: 'https://$(tenant).api.example.com'
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/k6-synthetic.sh'
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Check health and gate promotion'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                HEALTH=$(curl -s https://$(tenant).api.example.com/health)

                kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --namespace=$(tenant)
